name: Lykaia
summary: The Arcadian games of Zeus Lycaeus on Mount Lycaion — founded, Pausanias says, by Lycaon before the Panathenaia itself — athletic contests beneath the summit sanctuary where no living thing casts a shadow.
testimonia: Pausanias 8.2.1 (Lycaon founds Lycosura, names Zeus Lycaeus, and institutes the Lycaean games)
Pausanias 8.38.2–7 (the summit precinct, the altar, and the games)
Arcadian summer festival — the Attic month is a seasonal convention only
